artworks.title: John Tillotson
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person from the chest up, facing slightly to the left with a calm expression. The person has medium-length, wavy hair and wears a dark robe with a white clerical collar. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with decorative elements. The background behind the frame is plain. Below the portrait, there is a caption with the name and title of the individual.

artworks.title: Johann Tzerklas, Count of Tilly
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman or Lucas Vorsterman II
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a bearded man seen from the waist up. He faces forward with a solemn expression, featuring a mustache and pointed beard. His long wavy hair reaches past his shoulders. He wears a formal garment with a lace collar, an embellished robe, and buttons. The background includes a decorative border, heraldic crests, crossed flags and weapons above the man, and a scroll below the portrait with text. The engravings add a regal or commemorative touch to the image.

artworks.title: Johan Tzerklas, Count of Tilly
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man's portrait displayed from the chest up, facing the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and goatee, short wavy hair, and a serious expression. The man wears a fluffy ruffled collar and a dark, ornate garment, likely a cloak or robe with embroidery. Surrounding him is an oval frame with the inscription "Jean Conte de Tilly General des Armees de Sa Majeste Imperiale." Above the frame are two cherubic figures holding trumpets, with leaf and laurel decorations. The background includes detailed chains, classical motifs, a human figure in the lower left, and a reclining woman on the right, likely decorative elements. At the bottom, there is a scroll with additional text.

artworks.title: Johann Tzerklas, Count of Tilly
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode I after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned slightly turned with his right shoulder closer to the viewer, holding a sword in his right hand. The man has pronounced facial features, including a prominent nose and a finely groomed mustache that curls at the ends. His hair is short, wavy, and light-colored, complementing his neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He wears armor with a high, elaborate ruffled collar typical of the period. A large brick wall forms the background, with thick smoke or clouds swirling above.

artworks.title: Titian
artworks.description: This image shows a head and shoulder portrait of a man facing the left side. He has a long beard and a solemn expression, with deeply set eyes. his hair is mostly covered by a dark cap with some curls showing. He wears a fur-trimmed garment over a buttoned vest or coat made of rich fabric. The background is plain with a textured, line-drawn effect, with text above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Titian
artworks.description: This image shows a man's upper body facing slightly to the right with his gaze directed upward and to his right. The man has deep-set eyes, bushy eyebrows, long, thick beard, and mustache. He is wearing a robe with a fur collar, showing visible buttons. The background is plain with horizontal lines, emphasizing the engraving-style artwork. Text is positioned above and below the image.

artworks.title: Harboldus van Tombergen
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's bust within an oval frame. His face is turned slightly to his left, featuring a high forehead with a receding hairline, styled back hair, a full curly beard, and a connected mustache. The man's eyes are looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. He wears a high, pleated ruff around his neck, typical of an earlier fashion era. The engraving includes intricate details and Latin text surrounding the oval frame, as well as textured patterns in the background.

artworks.title: Johannes Torrentius, Dutch Painter
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Simon de Passe
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body with his torso angled slightly to the left. His head is turned toward the viewer, showing a prominent nose, a mustache, and wavy hair styled back from his forehead. He has a neutral facial expression and a hint of facial hair on his chin. The man wears a detailed garment with a high ruffled collar and patterned fabric on the sleeves and chest. An ornate oval frame surrounds him, adorned with decorative elements and text describing him. The frame features floral designs, a shield at the top, and intricate engravings in a classic style suggesting formality and artistry of the period.

artworks.title: Georg Tradel
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man in an oval frame with an intricate decorative border. The man has a prominent forehead, full cheeks, and a thick short beard and hair. He wears a collared garment. The border features classical motifs, including female figures on either side of the frame holding different objects. Above the man's portrait is an emblem with swirling designs, while below is a heraldic shield with lion figures. Additional decorative elements like fruits and ram heads are present. The background has a dense pattern, and there is Latin text below the main image.

artworks.title: William Trealong of Blois
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body within an oval frame. The man is positioned to the left but turns his head towards the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and styled back hair, wearing a high ruff around his neck. His clothing is decorative with intricate patterns, and a chain is draped across his shoulder. The background is an oval frame with an inscription encircling the portrait, and there is some text below the oval.

artworks.title: Tristan, the Hermit
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person seated from just below the shoulders upwards. The individual has wavy hair, a mustache, arched eyebrows, and a calm expression. He is wearing period clothing with a dark coat, wide collar, light-colored shirt, and a decorative lace cravat. In the background, there is an oval frame with intricate line work and text in French mentioning "Tristan Lhermite."

artworks.title: Nicolaes Pietersz Tulp
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man seated in a wooden chair with a rounded back post and studded upholstery. He is facing slightly to his right, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a moustache, goatee, and curly hair extending below a cap. He wears a collared garment with decorated buttons, and a dark coat or cloak over his shoulders. His right hand rests on his lap, while his left hand is relaxed at his side. The background is a dark, textured surface, and there is writing in a classical font below the image.

artworks.title: William Tyndale, Protestant Reformer and Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the torso up, facing forward with his right hand resting on a ledge. He has distinct facial features including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a full beard with lighter streaks. His hair is slick, parted on the side, and closely frames his face. The man wears a dark, formal robe with a high fur collar and an intricately pleated ruff around his neck. There are no jewelry or other adornments visible. The background features closely etched lines creating a textured effect, with no distinct objects or scenery. Latin text is inscribed below the portrait in an ornate script.

artworks.title: Pope Urban VIII (Maffeo Barberini)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, seated and slightly turned to the side, with one hand raised in a gesture. The individual has a long face with a prominent nose, full cheeks, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He is wearing a cap, a robe with a high collar and buttons down the front, and a ring on one finger. In his other hand, he is holding a small object. The background is plain, with an oval frame surrounding the figure and text at the bottom, including the name "URBANUS VIII. PONTIFEX MAX." and a date in Roman numerals.

artworks.title: Johannes Utenbogaert
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated and facing slightly to the right while making eye contact with the viewer. He has a short, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and closely cropped hair. He is wearing a formal garment with a high, pleated ruff collar and a fur-trimmed cloak. The background has an ornate oval frame decorated with elaborate scrollwork and the inscription "IOHANNES U TENN BOGAERT" along with additional text around the edge. The artwork suggests a historical context with decorative elements typical of portrait engravings, such as the intricate border and stylized frame details.

artworks.title: Johannes Uytenbogaert
artworks.description: The image depicts Johannes Utenbogaert's upper body. He is facing slightly to the right, looking at the viewer. He has a prominent mustache, wavey hair, a receding hairline, and a serious expression. He wears a textured ruff around his neck, typical of his era's attire. His clothing is formal and dark. In the background, there is a subtle lined pattern. Text at the bottom includes his name and some additional writing.

artworks.title: Johann Valentin Maier
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of an older man with distinct features, including deep-set eyes and long, gray wavy hair. He is wearing a dark cap and a dark garment with a wide white collar. The oval frame surrounding the portrait is decorated with Latin script, and there is a smaller crest below with an illustration and text. The background consists of dense hatch marks typical of engraving.

artworks.title: Marguerite de Valois, Wife of Henry of Navarre
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is facing slightly to her left with a serene expression. Her hair is styled in tight curls and she is wearing a richly decorated dress with jewelry. The background features ornate French text encircling the portrait, reading "MARGVERITE DE VALOIS ROYNE DE NAVARRE."

artworks.title: Marguerite de Valois, Wife of Henry of Navarre
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman from the upper half of her body. She is depicted in a forward-facing, slightly turned position, showcasing her detailed attire. The woman has distinct facial features, including high cheekbones, a delicate nose, and pursed lips. Her hair is styled in an updo with an elaborate headpiece featuring a decorative jewel. She wears a historical gown with an intricate pattern, pearls or jewels on the neckline and bodice, a choker-style necklace made of beads, and a high collar. The background is shaded with lines, and the portrait is framed in an oval with inscriptions stating "Margarita Valois" and "1589."

artworks.title: Barbara van Beck
artworks.description: The image presents an engraved portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is situated with her body facing slightly to the viewer's left, with her arms resting in front of her on a stringed musical instrument. The woman has a full face of hair, including a beard, wavy hair that extends beyond her shoulders, and wears a garment with large sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a wide collar adorned with a decorative bow. She is seated in front of a musical instrument resembling a zither or dulcimer on a table. The background features detailed lines for texture, and the bottom of the image includes a block of text in a foreign script.

artworks.title: Barbara van Beck, A Bearded Lady
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a person standing behind a zither on a table with a cloth. The person has long hair and a beard, wearing a dress with intricate details. A dog with a collar is present on the left. Background elements include a railing, balusters, columns, and an inscription above the person's head.

artworks.title: Richard Vaughan, Bishop of London
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing forward, with distinct features including a nose, cheekbones, and a full beard. He wears a hat with a rounded crown typical of the Renaissance period, along with textured clothing and an undergarment with intricate patterns near the collar. The background is detailed with crosshatching. Text at the bottom likely identifies the individual as Ricardus Vaughanus in Latin.

artworks.title: Francis le Mothe le Vayer
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing slightly left. His head is turned towards the front, showing his facial features. The man has a smooth expression with large, almond-shaped eyes, a high forehead, and long, wavy hair falling past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark garment with a white collar, typical of 17th-century fashion. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame within a larger rectangular frame, with patterns in the background. Below the image is an inscription in Latin introducing the man as "Franciscus Mothaeus Vayerius" with his titles. The image has a monochrome appearance resembling an engraved print.
